[L3] Luke 1:34.", "rule_words": "A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count.", "room": "'pressed it against that link': whether listing verses as links breaking a claim without quoting any earlier-round pressing sentence counts as pressing; I weighed the judge's own citation as sufficient versus the rule's explicit requirement of a quoted sentence and named round.", "why": "No earlier round is named and no earlier-round sentence is quoted, so the verses cannot count as pressed witnesses, yet the judge uses them to declare the link broken."}
